notes.title: Gunslinger Update now Available! - Patch 0.9.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/50340b0c499afddd3d8f0f9a70e7450b739f567d.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/34874367ee6adb3d834e3e9203e9099fe3119f7b.png[/img]

[h1]Gunslinger Update[/h1]
It’s High Nooo.. ahem, I mean.. it’s time for another new update, Dungeon Knight! This new update is focused on Classes. With big additions and changes to current classes and for the first time since the introduction of classes, a whole New class; The Gunslinger. All the classes and weapons and pets will now make use of the new elemental damage system, adding buff and debuffs to you and your enemies. This update also comes with some life improvements, including an interaction helper, quick setup options and height calibration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/c87a7584c1f4c93cdcf3c305197ddbe0d9c84857.png[/img]

[h1]Added: The Gunslinger [NEW CLASS] [/h1]
From the Westlands hails a legendary Hero. He is so quick on the trigger that his own shadow still loses in a duel. So deadly that not even fish in a barrel are safe from him. Grab your horse and let’s go to ye ol’ town road; it is time to introduce the Gunslinger. A new class in VR Dungeon Knight. While the normal knight goes in with a sword and shield, this class will focus more on the guns and rifles. With his high movement speed, he can easily gain some distance between him and the target. Guns in his loadout are faster and deadlier than ever before, but power comes with a price. Since this cowboy is to cool for armor, he is also the most vulnerable to damage. But on the upside: he got a really cool hat!

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*][b]Fastest in the West: [/b] Movespeed up 30%
    [*][b]Gunslinger: [/b] Shoot Ranged weapons 35% Faster.
    [*][b]One in the chamber: [/b]Load rifles 33% Quicker.
    [*][b]Ready to duel: [/b]All Rifles are automatically reloaded in each new room.
    [*][b]Not so fast: [/b] Projectiles Cripple and Bleed Enemies.
    [*][b]Very Light Armor: [/b]takes 40% extra Damage.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/efe6a6d6d6ac490d5ea5babf8243dad7791d8903.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Elemental System[/h1]
You don’t need to have an arrow on your head to benefit from the elements. After a lot of work behind the scenes, you can now make use of buffs and debuffs in the form of the elemental system. Burn your enemies to a crisp with fire, make them bleed over time, or slow them down with freeze. Weapons can now have all kinds of different elemental powers, Not only weapons use this elemental system: it is also possible to add buffs to classes, enemies, and pets.

[b]Added Elemental Damage [/b][list]
    [*][b]Fire: [/b] Damage over time.
    [*][b]Ice: [/b]Slow and nullify enemy resistances (projectile damage and magic damage).
    [*][b]Bleed: [/b] Damage over time and cripple (Slow).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/82bb66535b15b60b1314b4860758dd382ddf559a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/edf9b0f5a7bdef5602a23039b97f60fe20cb42da.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Class Reworks[/h1]
Classes are a big part of VR Dungeon Knight. You can buy and change them in the hero chamber. Adjust your skills point accordingly, and pick out matching weapons for the perfect build. Yet, we still think that could be more distinct with each class. Make them feel more unique and suited for different playstyles. That is why we gave each class a good rework. We changed up their stats and implemented the new Status system. They now give you different buffs and debuffs. We think that with this rework, each class will feel more different to play. These changes are a test, so more might follow in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/c9ddd88aec78691adec5944f0e8527287208ea72.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/328792643addc1fcea1db32723acf91d3a186118.png[/img]

[h1]Changed:  Assassin [CLASS][/h1]
Assassins are now more focused on stealthy gameplay. Making them faster, and harder to detect. Silent and very deadly from behind, especially with the use of daggers. They do take some extra damage, so use your skills wisely. 


[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*][b]Fast as the Wind: [/b]Movement increased by 33%.
    [*][b]Shadow walk [/b] Sneaking increased by 33%.
    [*][b]Assasinate: [/b]High damage while in stealth.
    [*][b]Silent but deadly: [/b] Greatly reduces noise. 
    [*][b]Sharpen my blade: [/b] Daggers Apply Bleed and Cripple effect.
    [*][b]Light Armor: [/b] Takes 25% damages
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/f0c051b51dcb46318d661ff484df49ee579667dd.png[/img]

[h1]Changed:  Warrior [CLASS][/h1]
Warriors are fierce fighters. They are the first to go into battle equipped with large swords and maces. Battle-hardened by all the previous fights, they can take a lot more damage than most heroes. While a bit slower, their divine protections help them shield incoming projectiles. 

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*][b]True Survivor: [/b]Incoming Damage Reduced by 10%
    [*][b]Take that![/b] 15% More Counter Damage
    [*][b]Mighty Rage: [/b]Blunt Weapons break enemy blocking.
    [*][b]Divine protection [/b] Blocks 1 projectile per room. (Arrows, small magic projectiles, throwing weapons).
    [*][b]Light Armor: [/b] Movespeed reduction 8%
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/c0ea5c2025aaedda327157b46de1b797e3e46da4.png[/img]

[h1]Changed:  Ranger [CLASS][/h1]
No one can escape their arrows. They retain absolute focus in the heat of battle. Rangers are masters of the bow. Drawing infinite arrows quiver to rain down death upon their enemies. 

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*][b]Silver Points: [/b]Arrows & Bolts do Double Sneak Damage.
    [*][b]Ready your Bow: [/b] All Quivers have unlimited stock.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/b999494e17d67c4b65f01187ad613e8fef64284c.png[/img]

[h1]Changed:  Thief [CLASS][/h1]
The Thief class is a master of stealth. While not so deadly as the assassins, they use their cunning skills and strategies to gain the upper hand. Plus they will get a good amount of gold for each kill they make. 

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*][b]Child of the Night: [/b]Sneaking increased by 20%
    [*][b]Swift feet: [/b] Movespeed increased by 33%.
    [*][b]Panther's Prowl: [/b]Sneak Damage increased by 25%
    [*][b]Tricks of the trade: [/b] Enemies almost can't hear you.
    [*][b]Bounty Hunter: [/b] Gets gold from each Kill.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/73db773ea00c975778607f3e28c3b1639337ea45.png[/img]

[h1]Changed:  Dungeon Knight[CLASS][/h1]
The Dungeon Knight is a true Tank. Fighting for the glory of all the Dungeon Knight before him. His dwarven forged armor can take a lot of damage in the heat of battle. Combined by his holy protection, he is a force to be reckoned with. However, his strength is no use in stealth. 

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*][b]I'm your shield: [/b]Incoming Damage Reduced by 16%
    [*][b]Heavy blow: [/b] Blunt & Two-handed weapons break enemy blocking
    [*][b]Build like a Tank..: [/b]Movespeed Reduction 16%
    [*][b]Holy protection :[/b] Blocks 4 projectiles per room (Arrows, small magic projectiles, throwing weapons).
    [*][b]..subtle like an Elephant: [/b] Enemies spot you quicker and Sneak Damage reduced by 40%
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/cbfce6830b6403c01468f8dc6d7864ca4173a240.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Life improvements[/h1]
For this next part. we would like to share a few insights into the production of VR Dungeon Knight. It started all in 2017, as a personal project of me (Thomas). It is a VR game that I’m building with a great amount of passion, something that never changed over the years. One thing that did change over the years, is the size of the projects. Each update adds a lot of new features and content, but also a lot of news frameworks, scripts, and systems. Since the game is now 3 years old, a lot of the previous updates are built on old frameworks and code, dating from the beginning of the development process. Not only the games has grown a lot since the beginning, but also our knowledge and experience. The VR community and games have grown as well, which makes us want to reach for even higher quality levels.

With each update closing in on the 1.0 version of VRDK. We want to aim for a fully polished version of the game once we hit that mark. This means that we putting a lot of time behind the scenes of VRDK.  There is a lot of old code to clean up before we can build in new systems, including a combat rework, AI and multiplayer systems. This is taking a LOT of work and It's not something I can show just yet. (Very WIP). With this rework in code, I hope to make development for dungeon knight a lot quicker and smoother to add more advanced content to the game even after the release of a 1.0 version. 

Here are some small few changes with a focus on life improvements and polish:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/9bb09320765c4ccc879fd038a823d3ee9270e4e8.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Interaction interface[/h1]
This new Interaction interface system helps to find interactable, like doors, keys, and items. 
When an interaction is closeby, a little UI icon shows up where to press with your controller.
It's very minimal and only shows up in handy locations. The icons will fade away from a distance. 

[b]The interaction icon shows up with:[/b][list]
    [*]Weapon Wall Pickups
    [*]Unlock Chest
    [*]Option room options
    [*]Doors
    [*]Skillpoint addition buttons
    [*]Hero Mode Option
    [*]Items
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/0a21e6ea6d661d73958bef5df8f357bc6219563a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/07cad96b5a87dd2e277b6e5dcea04c77ae06e4ac.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Height Calibration[/h1]
It is now possible to (re) Calibrate your player height. This option is now added to the options chamber. Height Calibration is a must for VR games and will make the game feel a lot better. This new feature makes it easier to reach for doors, grab things from the floor and even allows seated gameplay!

[b]Features [/b][list]
    [*](Re) Calibrated your height to recommended ingame height.
    [*]Options is located in the Option Chamber (on the right in the main Hub)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/ddd492ab12ff0c2c84bfb9e8c4289489603a4578.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Quick Setup[/h1]
We made some small adjustments to the quick setup menu at the beginning of the game. We reworked some of the explanations and features and we added the option for smooth turning. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/5fd95f0c1e1906a711d35dc0a061e87611348369.png[/img]

[h1]Removed: Panther VR Event[/h1]
The Mages Council of Aldun have concluded their research and closed the portal to a strange dimension. The Panther VR limited-time event has come to an end. The entrance to the Beta labs facility has been closed off. For more exploration and stealth action, check out our new game: Panther VR

[b]Features [/b][list]
    [*]Panther VR event ended: Removed Beta Labs Facility
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/234d27fbcda07deff9bb07137d9c5af7b861b4b2.png[/img]

[h1]Removed: Panther VR Weapons [/h1]
With the closing of the Portal also comes an end to other dimensional weapons. The Gohl-s and pipe wrench have been removed from the game. It is no longer possible to find these weapons, but they will stay in your weapons belt if you have them equipped. Mage Uldo stated: “I’m glad they are gone. My beard has finally grown back.”.

[b]Features [/b][list]
    [*]Removed Gohl-s 
    [*]Removed Pipewrench
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/779d818b0417e344ed437c16c8af86392bfd173f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/bceac864cf173a33409f5735ccc2f1f3309b14f4.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Tribal Bow[/h1]
Crafted from the wood of the Ancient tree. Blessed by a powerful shaman, cursed by a witch doctor. Over the years, this bow crossed a lot of different hands and tribes. Still containing the power and abilities bestowed upon its previous owners. Burn your enemies with fire, or freeze them with the power of ice. It’s is the first weapon that makes use of the new elemental system. A powerful bow with the ability to switch the elemental damage between fire and ice.

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Damage: 250
    [*]Can switch between normal Arrows, fire & Ice. (Elemental arrows don't stealth kill).
    [*]Fire: Does damage over time (Stacks).
    [*]Ice: Lowers resistances of enemies and slows them. (Stacks).
    [*]Fire and Ice effects can affect how some enemies behave.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/73e4ae9173890a9f4926b3359b54f25eafb54f65.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Mace of Blades[/h1]
What is more deadly than a Mace? A mace made of blades! That what they came up with at the Zorda Blacksmith Academy. With a design worthy of a hero, but the rudeness and power of mace directly to the face. A mace that handles like a sword! Or perhaps a sword that handles like a mace?

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Damage: 52
    [*]weight: 33
    [*]Legendary: Bleeding & Cripple Effect.
    [*]Hidden: This weapon must be found to unlock.
     
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/1498936e71a8bb0aacf226aae8d7b166511e6b52.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Slayer of Orclings[/h1]
It is the bane of all Orclings. A sword that turns all Orcs green with fear. The Orcling Slayer is a weapon that specializes in chopping down ugly Orcs. So if you hate them as much as the Dungeon Knights of Old, then now is your time to fight back! Find an Orcling slayer in a Dungeon near you today!

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Damage 70.
    [*]Weight 40.
    [*]Legendary: Evaporates Orclings.
    [*]Hidden: This weapon must be found to unlock.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/9b838531422c785bee5e49666c1c462c8363a93a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/d00e1716952b3aa912ec471dd8268382a0c747bf.png[/img]

notes.title: VR Dungeon Knight - Panther VR Special
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/54b45cf8428650759ed4436ef8877e28c6e6cb30.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/34874367ee6adb3d834e3e9203e9099fe3119f7b.png[/img]

[h1]Panther VR Special [LIMITED TIME ONLY!][/h1]

With great pleasure, we announced our new game: Panther VR! We launched a Kickstarter for the game and received a lot of positive feedback and support from our amazing community! While It is quite some time till the Early Access release of Panther VR, we still wanted to take the time to thank our fans and supporters while also giving you a little sneak peek of Panther VR.

We present to you: The Panther VR Special! A mini update for VR Dungeon Knight! Get a small Sneekpeak of Panther VR and explore the Beta Labs Facility and try out the Gohl-S, a new silenced weapon from Panther VR! It's a small update, but hopefully, it will give you a taste of Panther VR, or at least you will have a cool new gun for your collection! PS. it wouldn't be a VRDK update without an extra secret! 

Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/e5fce5bca6b88d5a9904dad66a26fd4f3bdd3ad5.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Beta Labs Facility[/h1]

The Mages Council of Aldun found a mysterious hourglass filled with great mystery. Legend says it can control the fabric of time itself. The mages tried to control its power, but have opened a portal to a different time and place. What is this new strange location? People behind the portal seems to have harnessed the power of electricity in small boxes. They use small powered machines to cure illness and to look at the pictures of cats. What a truly fascinating time. 

Explore a small portion of the Betal Labs Facility and find your new weapon!

[b]Check out this mysterious purple glow in the Main Chamber![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/3730d77293e63beaf9bbdb4b8f506d33693bd4e0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/f509dd7c83a454765b26016b0aad681040105c9e.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Gohl-s [Weapon][/h1]

We have another report from the Mages of Aldun. They found a mysterious weapon in this new dimension. It looks like a flintlock pistol, only without the need to reload after a shot. It seems to have a small metal pouch for bullets. Even stranger is that you don't even hear it shoot. It looks like a perfect weapon to sneaks up on an orc. Mage Uldo even stated: "They shot my beard right off, and I didn't even notice it!" 

You can now find and use the Gohl-S. A standard GUILD handgun issued to Panther agents. Equipped with a silencer, it's the perfect gun for a thief.  

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Damage: 105
    [*]Weight: 5
    [*]Firerate: Fast
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/d03edaa364017f797990336e0caf41a58fa83fe6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/2ddb1a53f200379961283398050447640488eee4.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Wrench [Weapon][/h1]

This new dimension keeps on giving. The Mages found some kind of legendary weapon. It's bright red, with a perfect grip and a good balance of weight. It seems to be crafted from a unfamiliar kind of metal. Strong yet still lightweight. The Arc Mage himself claims that this weapon must've had a glorious purpose in this unknown world.

You can also wield the powerfull Wrench. Well, actually, it's just an ordinary pipe wrench with no special powers. (just don't tell the Arc Mage). Still good for smacking an orc on the head! 

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Damage: 55
    [*]Weight: 20
    [*]Strikespeed: Medium
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/d647172223504b742cf6a6398ea5b72db806d46b.png[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/1287ee81b77c9d8477eca0e321402d462094dda0.png[/img]

We truly believe in the future of VR, which in our opinion, is driven by an amazing community. We want to fully involve this loving community in the production of Panther VR, just like we are doing with our other title. We need your involvement, feedback, suggestions, and ideas to bring this amazing game to its fullest potential!

If you love what we make for VR, please consider supporting us with our Kickstarter. Not only will you make a great contribution to the future of VR and our internal gratitude, but you also will receive a kick-ass new game!

notes.title: Panther VR - Announcement [NOW ON KICKSTARTER]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/427c679b341f44400d9306791a3d464b058c4e50.png[/img]

[h1]Hi guys, Thomas here,[/h1]

 I hope you are all doing great!

The Pet's & Beasts update was a blast and I can't wait to work on even more cool content requested by you guys! The pets are really cute and helpful and I loved seeing all the pictures and clips about them :) I get suggestions all the time and feel free to share your ideas for future updates. That's how this update came to be.

Now I want to share something with you guys, I have been working on VR Dungeon Knight for a long time and it's in an awesome place at the moment. Content is dropping at a nice pace and the game gets more polished every update. 

One of those reasons why is Wolfdog Interactive. They helped me with a lot of the new rooms in the game and took over most of the social and promotional tasks I had.
Making the last year of dungeon knight more incredible than ever. I think the game is in such a good and really fun place now. And I'm really glad I got help for that.

[h1]The big news:[/h1]
Wolfdog Interactive wanted to make a stealth-oriented VR game and needed a super awesome developer to enhance gameplay. (Me) Now I also wanted to make a Stealth game in a long time and since they helped me, I'll help them :) The game is called "Panther VR" and its shaping up to be an awesome stealth/heist based game.

Panther VR is now officially using the VR Dungeon Knight Character Movement and climbing System. This means that while developing dungeon knight I can enhance the Panther VR experience with little trouble!

[h1]What does this mean for development in VR Dungeon Knight?[/h1]
Simple answer;[b] Same Developer, More additional Content.[/b] Updates will continue in their original development time and I will proceed to make VR Dungeon Knight the best it can be. 
VR Dungeon knight is my true love and would NEVER think of letting down my many players and fans! Dungeon Knight is here to grow and get more awesome.

For the past 1,5 years, I have been helping on the development of Panther VR in a number of ways so you can already be sure that that has not changed my workflow and speed for developing Dungeon Knight. Wolfdog Interactive will also be more invested in Dungeon Knight and continue to enhance current levels and remake some of the old lost levels!.
These include the VR Dungeon Knight Snow Area's, The big underground mines (Mines of moria type), Cave levels, Fairy forests etc!

I like working on Panther VR and I love working in a team for once, I'm happier as ever!
Panther VR is going to be an additional favorite game in your Steam library. I'll make sure of it.

Because of your amazing Knights, I get to make games every day. And I want to make sure you guys are the first to grab some limited Panther Kickstarter pledges!
Take a look at the Kickstarter trailer to see me in action in the gameplay sections! It's really fun to play.

I hope you will support me in this amazing new chapter of my life, I will not let you guys down. Awesomeness awaits! :D

With love,

[h1]-Thomas[/h1]

[b][h1]TLDR; Panther VR doesn't affect VR Dungeon Knight Development. Updates will continue as usual. :)[/h1][/b]

notes.title: Pets & Beasts Update now Available! - Patch 0.9.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/6b7001678c1eb8990254960a87c37797592682d9.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/34874367ee6adb3d834e3e9203e9099fe3119f7b.png[/img]

[h1]Pets & Beasts Update[/h1]
Watch out, Dungeon Knight! This update is filled with creepy crawlers and furry friends. We are more than happy to give the Pets & Beasts update. With a game-changing new feature: Pets! These useful creatures will aid you in your battle against evil. Browse for your companion in the new Petshop and collect all your strength and courage to fight the Spider King, our new Boss. Take a look at the new Chamber of Heroes and discover new secrets hidden in the dungeons!

[h1]Next Update[/h1]
Once again we will be working hard on our next update (0.9.7). With this time a focus on more polish and refinement. If you have any ideas or things you want to see in upcoming patches, feel free to join the conversation on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/n4SrN28]VR Dungeon Knight Discord![/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/57195855dd3a61459734fe4f18fd3540203d1ee1.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Pets[/h1]
For a while, the fate of the world rested on the lonely shoulders of the Dungeon Knight, But even a Hero needs a little help sometimes. Introducing: Pets. A deadly and helpful companion to aid you in your dungeon adventures. You and your co-op partner now have the ability to bring a pet. You can choose from a variety of creatures to match your playstyle. (More will be added in future updates) They come in all shapes and sizes with each a different ability, damage range, and speed. Pets can help you in various ways:

[list]
[*] Pets can scout and detect approaching enemies.
[*] Pets can carry a weapon slot for the Dungeon Knight. (unlimited Weight)
[*] Pets can Attack and stun certain enemies.
[*] Pets only attack when you enter combat.
[*] Pets can keep you company in the dark and creepy Dungeons, so you never have to be alone again.
[/list]
You are only able to equip one pet at a time, or you can still choose to go in alone. Keep in mind though that pets don’t have a health pool. This means that they won’t aggro enemies or take any sort of damage. So find a furry critter today, and gain not only a helpful companion but also a new friend!    
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/5cd42b962efb186004e90284ce97491b623ee892.png[/img]

[h1]Added: PetShop[/h1]
Come in Dungeon Knight, take a look around. Welcome to the Petshop, a brand new location in the Main Chamber. Stop by, have a friendly chat with the Shaman Urk and browse the assortment of new pets. You can buy and unlock them with your hard-earned gold. Each pet comes with its own ability and (hefty) price tag. What about a wolf or maybe deadly T-rex? Urk makes sure you get the best prices and rarest of species! His stock is still quite fresh and new pets will be available in the future. Make a Suggestion and he might add it to the collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/cc025a6db0d2ac016daab76fe26779852a0909da.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/02dd9dac3babccee9d1e3261e54a7d852ff529d7.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Wolf [Pet][/h1]
For centuries the fierce wolf has been a loyal pet to the Dungeon Knights. It's loyalty, cunningness and agility are a perfect match to explore a Dungeon. Work together in a pack, and hunt down those pesky orcs. 

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Hunter: Hunts enemies down in combat.
    [*]Damage: 180
    [*]Movespeed Fast
    [*]Can carry 1 equipment item
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/25163c79e1267b2eb3764a11a47b0b08f19110b8.png[/img]

[h1]Added:  WolfBoss [Pet][/h1]
One wolf stood out from the rest. WolfBoss was the finest of all the wolves who served the Dungeon Knights. It was him who stood by the Dungeon Knight of Old when he defeated the Necromancer.

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Hunter: Hunts enemies down in combat.
    [*]Damage: 200
    [*]Movespeed: Fast
    [*]Has 2 equipment slots instead of 1.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/dd0082c4da33dbb14f1bc4c48da8511ee48b16ea.png[/img]

[h1]Added:  Raptor [Pet][/h1]
Life finds a way. Just like it did in the prehistoric forest of Turuk. A small but deadly creature emerges from the grass. This Raptor may look cute, but it is not advised to pet him, so says one-handed Pete. 

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Ambusher: Attacks nearby enemies.
    [*]Special: Has a lower attack cooldown.
    [*]Damage: 250
    [*]Movespeed: Medium
    [*]Can carry 1 equipment item
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/b24d87a05e22fa0c27dd4ed83fed9d458bfe75a5.png[/img]

[h1]Added:  T-Rex [Pet][/h1]
A powerful creature, millions of years old, built to kill and always in a bad mood. The T-rex joins the fight. Very deadly up close and not a pet to mess with. He just wants a hug sometimes.

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Ambusher: Attacks nearby enemies.
    [*]Powerhouse: Deals massive damage.
    [*]Damage: 350
    [*]Movespeed: Slow
    [*]Can carry 1 equipment item
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/167e38fd7481db5feb206cb2d06688f34fb8342b.png[/img]

[h1]Added:  Scarab [Pet][/h1]
From the deserts of Ka’van comes a royal and mysterious creature. The Scarab. is known as a guide to the pharao. While it is not built for strength and combat, you might want to take advantage of his other powers. 

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Does not like attacking...
    [*]Special: Nothing??
    [*]Damage: 25
    [*]Movespeed: Medium
    [*]Can carry 1 equipment item
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/942aa98aa7b1a6103055fd686eb840ca688c12e1.png[/img]

[h1]Added:  Mystery Pet [Pet][/h1]
Some pets are hard to find...

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Unknown
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/90c1b1efac8b1e57a512fde4c66b6c723452a8fd.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Spider King [NEW BOSS][/h1]
[b][i]*NOTE: Singleplay only[/i][/b]
There aren’t many beings that could scare even an orc. But one creature has them running for their lives: In crawls Zhirox, the Spider King. A descendant from the spider god Akir. This eight-legged creature lives deep in the "Caves of old beneath the Dungeon, searching for his next meal. Take on this legendary King, in a whole new Boss Battle! Muster all your strength and courage, seek out the Spider King in his hidden lair and collect his treasure. Just make sure you won’t be his next lunch!

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Attack: Poison Acid needle. (Unblockable, High Damage).
    [*]Attack2: SmokeScreen of Death.
    [*]Special: Can switch between Floor and Ceiling surface.
    [*]Hidden: This boss is hidden and must be found to defeat.
    [*]Optional: This boss fight is optional. So you don't have to fight a huge hairy spider if you don't want to.
[/list]
[quote=DeveloperComment]
[b]Developer Comment:[/b]
The Spider King is something completely different from other enemies and required a lot of new mechanics and systems. For this reason, we choose to make it a singleplayer only experience. This may change in the future after some thoroughly playtesting and development progress.  [/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/b5420f6ff47c820b7e5caef0c0e8a8f37530435e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/2e612bef87d963e5a848bcc8bf9cca287e412359.png[/img]

[h1]Changed: Chamber of Heroes[/h1]
The Chamber of heroes has been overhauled and restored to its former glory. For centuries it served as a home of the ancient order of Dungeon Knights. A temple build as a monument for all things sacred and pure. It houses the Crystal of Light, a great source of power for the Dungeon Knight.  A new place to adjust your Strength, Agility, and intelligence. We relocated the skills books for a better overview and made room for potential new classes. It's finally worthy of your Fame and strength Dungeon Knight.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/0ec0797e480d7660839c0a93b2905db3b31fb7fd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/7bfc20902b6a7e9f02b2270983bece379ec8e5c2.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Improved performance[/h1]
Once again the performance is one of our main priorities. We made more adjustments to increase the optimization of the game. Help us locate more performance issues on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/n4SrN28]VR Dungeon Knight Discord![/url] 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/779d818b0417e344ed437c16c8af86392bfd173f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/dd570caab5c691d136f8f82a05fdb0f04868cdfe.png[/img]

[h1]Added:  Battle Axe of the Gods[/h1]
This Battle Axe was wielded by a powerful Warlord. Forged as an ordinary axe in the Mines of Gamdoon, it was meant as a weapon to defeat the armies of the Evil Murval, God of Disease. The warlord took the axe to a high priest, who blessed the axe in his fortune. The Axe gained great power, however, was never used is a fight with Murval. Rumour says that the old Warlord died of a sudden illness. 

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Damage 90.
    [*]Weight 100.
[/list]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/70abab46495026a6bb8f8b2351c222cbe4d2e333.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28430459/f2acee11037329d405f40977aa9e7eae6b797095.png[/img]

Changed: Sorcerer

notes.title: Adventure Update now Available! - Patch 0.9.5
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/1010a6ed351bec2964120d7b26bd8ff961ca65e4.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/34874367ee6adb3d834e3e9203e9099fe3119f7b.png[/img]

[h1]Adventure Update[/h1]
A new Adventure awaits Dungeon Knight! We proudly present the latest update for VR Dungeon Knight. This update brings a new level of adventure to your dungeons with the addition of community requested Rooms, enemies, servants, and weapons. We added a massive performance update to make your dungeons raids even smoother and your frame rates higher. Also a big welcome to our new Composer: [b]Daniele Zandara[/b], who will be making new soundtracks for VR Dungeon Knight, including some amazing new tracks which are already included this update! 

[h1]Next Update[/h1]
We can also confirm that we are already hard at work on the next update (0.9.6). This new updated will be crawling to your Dungeon as soon as it is ready and is already one of our favorites yet! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/e3612795e1131a073cc1c70b0f2fcbfa0ccbfff0.png[/img]  

[h1]Added: New Rooms[/h1]
Time to explore some new uncharted areas! We've added a whole array of new rooms, locations, and secrets to explore. Including the new Forgotten Dungeons, Mystic Caves and a  whole new Trap room with Game Master Goblin.

[h1]Forgotten Dungeons[/h1]
Some Dungeons are better left forgotten. These once mighty halls are now only roamed by lost souls and damned creatures. Do you have what it takes to purge the evil from the darkest depths?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/9c444076b30f747aa2d77a942eb0afbc2c0a4de3.png[/img]

[h1]Mystic Caves[/h1]
Old sages and druids used the Mystic Caves as their sacred ground for rituals and mysterious forms of magic and runecrafting. With big open rooms and small bridges, this location is one of our biggest yet in VR Dungeon Knight. Are you able to discover all of its secrets?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/c9e18a1aab201f4ed3d7a59c53bcecf4553fa94f.png[/img]

[h1]New Trap room[/h1]
Meet Game Master Goblin. He likes cats, long walks on the beach and blowing stuff up. He invites you to his room which is all filled up with explosions and bombs. (and no cats). Find the key before the time runs out and you will be able to escape the room without.. exploding of fun!
The Game master goblin is already working on other deadly trap rooms for future updates.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/77e18defd3908e1b9955529056048d0800fd75fc.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/e237525c68e325086cce331a8e9d90166e5be2d3.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Sorcerer of the Arcane Madness (Servant of the Necromancer)[/h1]
The true power of magic comes from Madness. This Sorcerer of old used to serve the Dungeon Knight until he traded his soul to the Necromancer in exchange for eternal life. He used his new found life to learn all sorts of tricks and dark magic slowly pushing him mad with power. His eternal deal, however, can still be broken by the death of the Necromancer. Only you can give your old servant the rest that he deserves. 

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Damage: 28 (Ranged: Axe of Madness)
    [*]Health: 700
    [*]MoveSpeed: Fast
    [*]Special Ability: Teleportation
    [*]Dodging: Can Dodge to avoid close combat
    [*]Throwable: Lantern of Madness (65 AoE Damage)
    [*]Projectile Armor: 85%
    [*]Magic Resistance: 90%
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/4e27a4aea01baeb95174fbc1ad5fdb0d28bd6967.png[/img]

[h1]Added:  God of Orcs (Servant of the Necromancer)[/h1]
The work of the Dungeon Knight is a Blessing for most but can be a curse to others. In the eyes of the Orcs, the Dungeon Knight is a true menace. A plague that must be eliminated. The orcs have called forth their champion, the God of Orcs, to slay the Dungeon Knight once and for all. All hail the God of Orcs!


[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Damage: 45 (God Sword)
    [*]Health: 1800
    [*]MoveSpeed: Low
    [*]Special Ability: Rage (75% Damage Reduction when life goes under 40%).
    [*]Throwable: Magic Axe
    [*]Projectile Armor: 15%
    [*]Magic Resistance: -25%
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/04f53baa39f6cd243adb671d9e24334eaa7a7449.png[/img]

Increasing the performance of the game is one of our highest priorities for full release. Due to the high atmospheric environments, the game can sometimes demand a lot of resources to load or run. After long and heavy hours of work, we're finally able to reduce resource loading drastically, which in return results in a much higher framerate and experience.

notes.title: Hero Update now Available! - Patch 0.9.4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/2b64b8446b30f0021f65e09a8afa5971c8b76114.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/34874367ee6adb3d834e3e9203e9099fe3119f7b.png[/img]

[h1]Hero Update[/h1]
A new year has arrived for VR Dungeon Knight! We had an amazing 2018 with a lot of new content and updates! Thanks a lot for all the great feedback and support! You can all rest assured that this year will, yet again, be filled with updates and improvements, starting with this brand new Hero update! So grab your nearest Dungeon buddy and let's start by exploring this new update!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/2e68867d2f0ae8bf8522eccc48c8c7426af4bc53.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Hero Mode[/h1]
Only the oldest legends speak about the Tree of Heroes. An ancient being which grows on heroic deeds and acts of kindness. Her presence alone can cleanse all evil from your heart. Only the most skilled fighters and mages will survive her blessing. Heroes have a lot to lose. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/0ceab128bde22827a8467a064b87648ca553d871.png[/img]

[b]How to activate Hero Mode[/b]
You can find the Tree of Heroes inside the Chamber of Heroes in the back of the room.
Approach the Tree by taking a [b] "Leep of Faith" [/b]and interact with the Helmet to activate her blessing. This blessing will engage “Hero Mode”. An indication of Hero mode will appear on your belt. This mode will change the following:

[b]Features Hero Mode[/b]
[list]
    [*]Take twice as much damage
    [*]All healing is reduced by 50%
    [*]Receive 3 times the normal XP
[/list]

[quote=Developer Comment]We got a lot of feedback on how the "Hard" Dungeon mode is still not hard enough. We hope that we can satisfy the craving for a hardcore Dungeon Run by adding a "Hero mode" that increase the difficulty immensely and give the game a whole new feeling. Enjoy![/quote]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/1f8a80a26ce7dfb462d7906d1789eea8fd890a41.png[/img]

[h1]Changed: Prologue[/h1]
A great adventure starts with a good introduction and proper training. That is why we reworked the prologue of the game. This includes a visual update of the introduction story and the addition of a new tutorial area for first-time players. The Tutorial area introduces the player to all the different mechanics in VR Dungeon Knight. There is a special area for Agility, for the introduction of climbing and swimming, an area for Ranged Combat, for the training in bow and spells, and we have an area for Melee Combat, where you can train your skills with sword and shield. First-time players can decide if they want to skip the tutorials. You can always find and replay the tutorial in the Main Chamber besides the Option Room

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/29252f43f2732c8d136281deb989c98c538b4cd9.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/b487efb6b99c2f25d01ddef0e63c66d672035c15.png[/img]

[h1]Changed: Backslot[/h1]
We reworked the Backslot system. The old version was built on a single back point, which was not easy to reach for some and made the wielding of items on the back way too tricky. The new system is more based on player height and hand position. This makes the range of the back slot larger, extending it behind the head and shoulders.  It is now easier to place and grab weapons on your back. 

[quote=Developer Comment]This rework was a largely requested feature from the community. We hope this will increase the usage of the backslot, especially with Player who are using VR System without 360 tracking. [/quote]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/2bc2759ecc2660191f77ec8fd6ed074dee0da51d.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/fad005aaf5720c6d8ae9f06ca6f1746dad21723b.png[/img]

[h1]Changed: Magic[/h1]
After many hours of reading ancient and dusty spell books and with an online learning course from a British Magic school, we discovered how we can improve our magic. All spells are now more accurate, making it more consistent to hit enemies from afar. We also added subtle aiming assistance, which shows where your spells will land. The assistance can be turned off any time in the Options Room. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/28756615ed39ca447b6154f69262402e1d92ac96.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/7e3f030e407c7592c773228783605e3c4fb44828.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Blood Options[/h1]
We added the option to change the appearance of blood. You can change the look from real blood to a cloud of white dust. This option is accessible in the Options Room.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/4ff47e84b9501537fa72f69193c94abd9e29b27c.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Adaptive Dungeons[/h1]
We’ve expended the Winstreak adaptation System. This system balances the Dungeons difficulty based on your previous performances. It makes the Dungeons more difficult and longer when you win but slightly easier and shorter when you lose, it now also makes enemies more fierce, attacking faster and more aggressive. The main goal of the system is to balance the gameplay for each player individually, giving new players a boost, and longtime veterans a challenge.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/2d7ddcf6fc7f692cf5b3d202841a340efa2b8bea.png[/img]

[h1]Changed: Combat[/h1]
Combat has been enhanced  in both speed and action. We lowered the amount of slow motion to focus more on the on quick blocks! The Enemy stun duration from blocks have also been lowered by 25%, for a feast recovery. Enemies are now more adaptive on the playstyle you prefer for improved counter attacks.

notes.title: Utility Update now Available! - Patch 0.9.3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/689a8ea3c103e38f322e57b1dd2c9eda49dc4765.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/34874367ee6adb3d834e3e9203e9099fe3119f7b.png[/img]

[h1]Utility Update[/h1]
After a full year of amazing new weapons, dangerous enemies and mysterious rooms, the time has come for some well-deserved gameplay updates. This brand new Utility update will be mainly focussed on the improvement of existing gameplay elements before we move on to the next big content additions. We want to iron out some small bugs and make the game feel overall smoother and easier to use. Included in this new patch are interaction improvements, movement system changes, and some huge requested multiplayer fixes. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/dcf89400fa9a28e52162679006c605adab91486b.png[/img]

[h1]Changed: Item Storage[/h1]
We’ve upgraded the item interaction system, making it easier to control your weapons and loadout, especially during combat. Grabbing and storing items has been polished.
You will now be less likely to store your weapon by accident in combat with the addition of a very small cooldown to avoid double storing or grabbing by accident.[quote=Developer Comment] This short cooldown will be a great improvement for Oculus users, due to the sensitivity of the touch controllers.[/quote]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/c67e50302c45de73a524e2be5a6c6d3e34259408.png[/img]

[h1]Added Spectator Cam[/h1]
In the rare event of death during an epic battle besides your fellow Dungeon Knight, you now have to option to watch the living in the Spectator Deathcam. We’ve installed a viewing window in the dark and empty void of death to view your continuing adventure of your still lively friend. The spectator cam is in a Third Person view and tries to follow your partner as close as possible. If your co-op partner enters the next room, you respawn and the spectator cam will end. It is still possible to communicate with the living using voice chat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/a927780a2b58b23727c6e6e9a3cc4da9d8485107.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/3feb81ec60f20d22bad620b483bebf7a8b619562.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Movement Systems[/h1]
This update comes with some new changes and additions to the movement system. We’ve tweaked the teleporting system with the addition of a cooldown, and added a smooth turning option for more immersion.

[b]Teleport Cooldown[/b]
In order to contain the distance you traverse through teleportation, we’ve added a cooldown. The teleportation cooldown will be based on distance and fast usage, making it impossible to fast spam your teleportation button. The cooldown is barely noticeable at normal speed movement, so it won’t prevent your movement during combat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/8b52414f963ebd595180816410f8b2137bc0ede0.jpg[/img]

[b]Smooth Turning[/b]
Beside the already implemented snap turning, we’ve added a new smooth turning option. This removes the snap and fade, giving you full control over the rotation. This option is turned off at the start of the game and can be turned on in the Option Room on the far Right.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/49f0e4b166e7295a7d12467218587b0f30b64751.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/ed9683bfb4838ee2c97a564e6e9835eaab3e9a97.png[/img]

[h1]Changed: Throwing[/h1]
The throwing system is now enhanced, giving it more room for different throwing styles. We’ve noticed that almost everyone has his own unique way of throwing stuff. Some people throw underhands, some upper and others even throw sideways. In order to conform more to those different styles, we made throwing more dependent on your looking direction. This makes Throwing much more reliable and easier to execute with all throwing styles. Throwing direction is now based on where you look. (Look higher to throw higher) and its speed now only uses the local speed of your hands.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/f9637f7ed583825ec60fd0f236089b159c3fae9a.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/d37b462d0da0eb49ae2eb834de6751671a82aa82.png[/img]

[h1]Changed: Menu Interaction[/h1]

You can now interact with a menu with only the press of the trigger button. These interactions can mainly be found in the Heroes Chamber and Options Chamber.

notes.title: Musket Update now Available! - Patch 0.9.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/60fc49cb4582a437c438e72e806ac94ff0412831.png[/img]

[h1]Musket Update[/h1]
Another new update rolls out for VR Dungeon Knight. It's full of guns a new enemy and new adventures.

[b]Added Muskets[/b]
It is time to pack some heat Dungeon Knight! We’ve added the muskets to your armory. These rifles are a great way to deal a large amount of damage from a good distance. Each musket has its own speciality, like the sniper rifle for large distances and the rifle axe for close combat. All rifles must be reloaded manually after each shot by holding the rifle in both hands while holding your hands close together. Muskets can be unlocked like any other weapon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/67e69dac2a86fcfd6f4e2e3949f0403299aeca5a.png[/img]

    [*]Can't Block.
    [*]600-2400 Ranged Damage Potential
    [*]Can pierce through walls/floors and all enemies in a line.
    [*]Does not have a sneak damage multiplier.
    [*]Loud sound! Enemies will detect you faster after you shoot.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/0dbdd4500d90dfaed4ae3dac19457b8a8a2b0b79.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Musket Sniper (Blackmark Weapon)[/h1]
Snipe your enemies from afar with this deadly high ranged rifle. (Or try a no scope.)

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]

    [*]Can't Block.

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/73cada0bd4c88e48fe936b70ac7ab6fb1dc581ad.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Axe Rifle (Blackmark Weapon)[/h1]
What is better than an axe? An axe with an ability to shoot your enemies in the face!

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]40 Melee Damage.
    [*]Can Block.
    [*]640 Ranged Damage.
    [*]Can pierce through walls/floors and all enemies in a line.
    [*]Does not have a sneak damage multiplier.

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/8d3c787eb2d99dd44f8b61d9a472c5368c1c3914.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Sorcerer of Unholy Order (Servant of the necromancer) [/h1]
Once sworn to protect the world from evil. The order of Sorcerers could not withstand the corruption of the Necromancer. Now they dedicate their lives and power to dark magic and destroying any Dungeon Knight in their path.

[b]Abilities and Statistics [/b][list]
    [*]Melee Damage: 30
    [*]Can fire magic
    [*]The magic projectile is homing.
    [*]Can Teleport at will.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/b4ad36d72d98966368f5391a57ba23dad815c7da.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Adventure Mode and Nightmare Mode[/h1]
We have replaced the normal and hard difficulty with an Adventure and Nightmare Mode. 

[b]Adventure Mode[/b]
This mode will generate a Dungeon with a combination of traps, exploration and enemy rooms. It has a more relaxed pace and gives the player a mix of exploration, combat, and adventure. It's the perfect setting for starting players and shows every aspect of a Dungeon. 

[b]Nightmare Mode[/b]
The Nightmare mode is a more hardcore approach to the dungeons. It only uses rooms with enemies in it, making it more focused on combat and survival. Large rooms without enemies are removed, and the player doesn’t get a lot of breaks between fight. Advised for more experienced players. 

[quote=Developer Comment] We felt that the old difficulty setting (normal and hard) weren’t that different from each other. A lot of players only went for the hard setting, which made the normal setting almost redundant. We also noticed that some player love exploring, while others mainly want to fight. By separating the modes from playstyle instead of difficulty we hope that more players will choose one of the two Dungeon depending on what they want to do. [/quote]

[h1]Added: Portal of Souls[/h1]
The old Multiplayer doors are replaced by the Portal of Souls. Besides the appearance change, it also has a different way to use it. When there is a game available a portal will appear, allowing you to step through and join a fellow Dungeon Knight on his quest.
The portal will make it easier to spot and join an available game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/e9a766bb1e596f1326869b2adbc9b3c9bd434eda.png[/img]

[h1]Changed: Stealth Trial[/h1]
You will now need 75% of your kills to be stealth takedowns in order to succeed the stealth trail. (instead of no detection) If you remain in stealth while proceeding to the next room all the monsters you skip in the previous room also get added to your stealth kills count. Neat!
Monsters you skip mid-combat will get counted to your normal kills count though.

[h1]Added: New Temple Dungeon Rooms[/h1]
We added some new Temple themed Dungeon rooms. These rooms will expand on the one already in the game and will focus more on exploration and combat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/70d3823446da2d0e482c4a62431b7987205f7146.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Carry Weight[/h1]
Your movement speed is now capped based on your weight! You know that indicator on your belt. All items and weapons have a weight that will add to your total weight. This will make you slower with large and heavy weapons. This applies to Touchpad Movement AND armswing. Teleportation will receive a cooldown in between jumps based on the weight and distance in a later update. If you want to be a true speedrunner in this update you need to invest points into dexterity or purchase the thief/assassin class to achieve a fast speed. A heavy knight class with heavy weapons now also plays like one.

    [*]Heavy is 55% of your total movespeed.

[h1]Combat Update[/h1]
We have some great new additions and changes to how combat plays out in VR Dungeon Knight. These new features will add extra depth and difficulty to your dungeon runs. 

[b]Special Abillties[/b]
All enemies now have a special Ability. This special Ability gives them an extra way to attack the player. Like a Rage mode for the Orcs, giving them extra damage and attack speed for a short time. Together with the enemies new ability to dodge your attacks, it adds a lot of depth to your fights. Forcing you to rethink your strategy and approach.

[b]Blocking[/b]
Blocking has been reworked and is now more responsive. Making it easier to block and dodge incoming attacks. 

[b]Training[/b]
We've added a training area in the Weapons Room. These areas are split up in melee and ranged, with the addition of Training dummies. You can now test the strength of your weapons, or try out some tactics before entering a dungeon. 

[b]Loadouts[/b]
Your loadout and dungeon difficulty will now be saved when you enter a dungeon. When you finish a dungeon or die, you can jump back in with the same loadout.

[b]Decapitation[/b]
Slay your enemies in style. You can now cut off their heads with a final blow!

[b]Trap Rooms[/b]
Discover the new Trap Rooms. Escape from certain death by finding your way out before it is too late!

[b]Swimming[/b]
The Dungeon Knight can now swim in water. Making it possible to dive below the surface.

notes.title: Trap Update now available! - Patch 0.8.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/e5134c8a390eb5e2352140be8e56b56d77419e51.png[/img]

Hi guys Thomas here! I hope you guys will enjoy the new update!! Remember to post your player feedback and share the news!

Also I made some new awesome friends and I'm doing a livestream:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/566860/announcements/detail/3388269626438340650

And now for the update:

[h1]Traps[/h1]
All of the dungeons are now filled with traps you can encounter. These traps are randomly placed around set locations inside hallways and chambers.
==============
[b]Added: Fireball Trap[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fires a fireball in an area in front of the trap.
    [*]Can not be destroyed.
    [*]Recharges in between shots.
    [*]Can be tricked into activation by moving your weapon in front of it.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/0d2b428b524c9ef55993271bfa29a283825c2af7.png[/img]
==============
[b]Added: Stalker Trap[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fires a homing fireball in an area in front of it.
    [*]Can be dodged by quickly moving out of the way.
    [*]Can not be destroyed.
    [*]Recharges in between shots.
[/list][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/8033b76e892ee631be99bf972eaea7e8941a74cd.png[/img]
==============
[b]Added:Spike Trap[/b][list]
    [*]Spikes are activated when walking over or near the trap.
    [*]Located on floors and even walls.
    [*]Can not be destroyed.
    [*]Can be tricked into activation by moving your weapon in front of it,
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/061e2c9a21f8a9466d050dc5e7f1a077a6d558dc.png[/img]
==============

[h1]Drop-In Co-op[/h1]
You can now activate Drop in Co-op when you are in the main chamber. This makes it possible to start a dungeon alone and have people join or leave while you play. 

When someone else is hosting a public drop-in Co-op Session you will get notified in the main chamber with a sound and message above the multiplayer door. Stepping through this door takes you to the Drop in Co-op match of that player.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/8a2a501b21ed923bbde6de6dcbccc8cc846e06d9.png[/img]
==============

[h1]Servant of the Necromancer[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/efcd966f1cd5ebc30a268f71c4e8c6b40b065c64.png[/img]
A servant of the necromancer appeared! He will try to make your dungeon runs a lot harder. He can appear at any moment, with a sole purpose of killing you and your party.

The first Servant added to the game is called the "Spectral Summoner". The Servant will spawn smaller enemies, teleport to safety when you get too close and shoot you down with stalker fireballs.
Get close and strike fast to drop him to the ground. Here you can slash and bash him for a few good seconds. If you don't manage to finish him he will try to teleport away to safety.

Defeating this Servant clears the "Mini Boss" Challenge and unlocks the Bonus Room at the end of the Dungeon. Servants spawn randomly and only appear when you get seen in a dungeon, making sure that stealth playthroughs are viable and not interrupted.
[b]Abilities and Statistics[/b][list]
    [*]Ranged Only
    [*]Shoots stalker fireballs
    [*]1200 Health Points, a little more than the Red Orc or Big Bones enemy.
    [*]Can teleport at will.
    [*]Has a teleport escape when in danger.
    [*]Gets scared when you get too close, giving you a few seconds to strike.
[/list]
==============
[h1]Weapon Changes[/h1]
[b]Changed: Short bow[/b]
The Short bow is now bigger in size and needs to be pulled much further than before. The sounds have also been adjusted and rumble has been added to simulate string tension. Arrows now leave a trail behind them so it's easier to adjust shots accordingly.[list]
  [*]Shorter pull range
  [*]Added arrow trail
[/list]
==============
[b]Changed: Pistol[/b]
The Pistol model has been updated and now features a hand animation when you do a reload spin or do a grab spin from your belt.[list]
  [*]Slower fire rate, but more damage (from 40 to 75)
  [*]Bullet now fly faster making far away targets easier to hit.
  [*]Added Bullet trail
[/list]
==============
[b]Changed: Light Crossbow[/b]
The Light Crossbow now also features a hand animation when you do a reload spin or do a grab spin from your belt.The bolts also have a trail added to them and are now easier to make follow up shots.[list]
  [*]Lowered Bolt range
  [*]Added Bolt trail
[/list]
==============
[b]Changed: Spellbooks[/b]
All Spells can now be cast a little faster, making Group ambushes easier to clear. Reworked hand animations for charging and casting spells.
[list]
  [*]Faster cast time
  [*]Spell are less accurate
[/list]
==============

[h1]Graphics Overhaul[/h1]
The VR Dungeon Knight graphics are reworked and old effects replaced with new and more performance friendly features/image effects.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/e4afaac0c04090afe92b472832435a6946a6ab9c.png[/img]
[b]Added: HDR (High Definition rendering)[/b]
The game now supports a bigger color range then before.
==============

[b]Added: Horizon Based Ambient Occlusion[/b]
This adds more depth to models and structures. Giving you a more robust experience. This option can be toggled on/off in the option room to save on performance.
==============

[b]Added: Depth of Field[/b]
This adds more depth to models and structures. Giving you a more robust experience. This option can be toggled on/off in the option room to save on performance.
==============

[b]Added: Bloom[/b]
Magic, lights and explosions now all light up giving a more real and epic look.
==============

[h1]AI Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Ranged enemies will now advance and get in your line of sight when you stay behind cover for too long.
    [*]Smaller enemies will now attack in groups.(Spectral clubber, Skeleton Archer, Spectral Summons)
 [*]Group enemies will try to flank you and attack from behind or sides.
 [*]All grouped enemies have their health reduced.
[/list]
==============

[h1]Enemy Changes[/h1]

[b]Changed: Orc[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/101e4d5d68513f9f4e764ed010a80b1edd281bf7.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Health has been changed from 900 to 1000.
    [*]Orcs now have a max spawn of 4 instead of 5.
[/list]
==============

[b]Changed: Bones[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/13bfe054db30bce941672dd44e68f5530a8c82eb.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Health has been changed from 1200 to 1100.
    [*]Changed the model to be more grim and dark.
[/list]
==============

[b]Changed: Clubber[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/f415641bc0f477786f5c363fc017ea82069d4f8c.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Health has been changed from 200 to 50
    [*]Now attacks in groups.
    [*]Will use teleportation to jump around the map at will, trying to flank you or attack from behind.
   [*]Damage reduced from 12 to 9.
[/list]
==============

[b]Changed: Sourcerer[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/a3642a0c3b8a4a182659fcb91e255cf500fb6110.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Damage reduced from 14 to 9.
    [*]AI reworked to be more aggressive.
    [*]Will use teleportation to jump around the map at will, trying to flank you or attack from behind.
[/list]
==============

[b]Changed: Ghost[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/43ec369b6f6c1481ba6611004b35c669d7a9525b.png[/img]
When you enter a haunted room with ghosts, being present among them can cause a disturbance, turning off all torches and your lantern. Leaving you in the dark.
==============

[b]Changed: Skeleton Archer[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/2b0306579414520220e7c4b293c659c130f6210a.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Now attacks in groups.
    [*]Health reduced from 100 to 25.
    [*]Skeleton Archers are now more aggressive.
   [*]Attack range increased from 11 meters to 18.
[/list]
==============

[h1]Mechanics and additions[/h1]
[b]Dropping Items[/b]
Lots of new players drop their weapons by accidentally holding the grip button. It now requires you to hold grip for 0.35 seconds minimum and press the trigger button to drop a weapon.

[b]Hand Animations[/b]
New hands have been added to the game alongside with new animations. Added new animation for climbing and items.

[b]Blocking[/b]
Blocking is more reliable when aiming for the enemy weapon.

[b]Long attack strikes and fast Follow-up hits[/b]
Striking the enemy with fast follow up hits now works better and does more damage. The faster you attack the less damage you do.

[b]Hitbox reworks[/b]
Hitting enemies is more reliable with melee and ranged attacks.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28430459/c3443c843b5e3ccce26a334f19758f98a398ce1e.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update is live! Healing, Combat Changes and Performance Boost!
notes.content:
Send me your experience/feedback in the discussions!

Combat should feel better, crashes have been worked on and your frames per second should be almost doubled in most area's.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Things added in the update:

-You now turn 45 degrees.
-Turning is now changed to clicking left and right instead of swiping.
-Turning 180 degrees uses a top press on the touch pad instead of down.
-Option to use the old swipe turning mechanic
-Option to choose between 45 and 90 degree turning
-Updated the Game Engine to the latest version.
-Polished Combat.
-Added Swing Sounds to weapons. Blunt sounds and Sharp Sounds.
-Added Haptic feedback to swings.
-Added Enemy Death Animations
-Added Replay Tutorial Option.
-Added Steam Name of your last co-op partner in the multiplayer lobby. (From now on).

Added Volume options:
-2 Music Volume Levels (Low and Normal).
-Mute Music (So you can play your own).

-Blackmark Shopkeeper is now a pseudo random room. So everytime you don't get it you will have a higher chance you do next time. 
Example: (1-50, 1-49, 1-48) etc.

-Increased Frames per second and Occlusion Culling Performance.

COMBAT:

-Added Physics to enemy limbs and overal body balance when you hit them.
-Added dramatic Death Grunts to enemies.
-Added Death Ui on kills.
-Changed the the ghostly Clubber enemy.
-Adjusted Combat to make combo's and faster hits more realible.
-Nerfed/removed Wiggling melee weapons.
-Larger and longer swings with melee weapons do increased damage.
-You can now throw weapons
-When you throw a weapon at the right distance at a enemy you can catch it again.
-Hand Axe, Daggers and the spear do increased throw damage.
-Added new enemy animations
-Added Different animations depending how heavy/big the enemy is.
-Added Blocking for enemies.
-Added Counter Attack for enemies. (When you attack their block move)..
-Added Swing Trails.
-Added HealthBars for enemies. (Can be disabled).
-Added Visable Hit Impact on weapons.
-Added New sounds.

PERFORMANCE & FPS INCREASES:

-Changed how lighting works.
-Removed some image effects.
-Reworked complex dungeon structures.
-Optimised Player.
-Optimised Enemies.
-Optimised Weapons.

HEALING:
-Adding Healing potion with liquid physics.
-Working on random healing stations around the dungeon.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Hello Dungeon Knights,

The New update is released! This update will include the new combat system, healing potions, healing stations, improvements to performance and much more mentioned in this post.

The new combat took me a lot of time to get right, I have been in my room swinging controllers at my enemies for way too long. Broke my room clock and some other stuff along the way. (gets a little too immersive from time to time). All worth it in the end though ːsteammockingː

The new combat applies physics, blocking and counter attacking for enemies.

I would love to get your thoughts and feedback on the new update when it launches early next week.

I'm very excited to share the new features and improve the game, it's been a blast and I love working with you guys to expand and improve the game every update.

I'm so glad that I have a dedicated community to work with that gives me idea's feedback and suggestions, it really keeps me motivated and I'm happy I can do this for a living, creating a game that we all want to play ːsteamhappyː

Thanks again guys,
I hope you all have a nice day!

-Thomas Blackjard Softworks

notes.title: New Structures, New Rooms, New Weapons, Splitscreen Fairy Mode, Combat Polish, Inventory Update and more!
notes.content:
New stuff! I have been working hard to create new area's in the game, and not just new dark hallways but bigger and open area's inside and outside!

Even more rooms and area's will come over time.

If you like the new additions, don't hesitate to leave a review! It helps me out more than you think!

Let's get into the new additions:

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Lights & Brightness

-A lot of the rooms have been made less dark so you can see better.

-The Lantern has been improved and will create more light and have more reach, making it a better option.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Music/Sounds Update

-New music was added to the new rooms and area's
-New sounds where added to equipping weapons.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Movement Polish

You now move slower to the sides and back, this balances gameplay and lowers the chance of motion sickness.

-Fixed A bug where sometimes you would move without moving the touchpad.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Combat Polish/update

Enemies now always react to any incoming damage source. They flinch, stagger and get interrupted. 

Bigger enemies will however break trough potential perma stuns after a couple of hits.

Attacks that do heavy damage like: Heavy Sword - Claymore - Fireball, will now stagger/stun enemies to create more space in combat.

-Skeleton Archers now have less health.
-Pistols now do 35 damage instead of 40.
-Bringer of storms now shoots faster.

-2 Handed weapons all got a damage boost, but are even weaker when used with 1 hand.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

New Weapons, 

You can now collect tokens around the dungeons (like gold and XP books) and trade them in for special enhanced weapon chests. These tokens are hard to find and require you to look around a lot more!

There currently is 1 special weapon that you can get, more will come over time.

Extra: 2 Handed Claymore was added to the weapons chamber.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Fairy Mode,

A friend in the same room can now join in as a fairy on the same computer in splitscreen, the fairy sees the world as a map, (Topdown). So now you can play together instead of take turns playing at home!

The fairy is passive and can't attack or be seen but can do some other things like:

-Be a additional lightsource for the main player.
-Can locate gold, XP books and Keys on the map
-Perfect for scouting ahead of the dungeon knight.
-Can Reveal enemy positions and communicate where they move.

You control the fairy by using the keyboard. Press space to join in.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

New Chambers and Area's

Even more rooms are being added and new locations. 

You will now be able to explore demonic and larger rooms or explore the new temple villages or cross a huge bridge over a lake and knock orcs off them between 2 connected dungeons. Try and find your way trough cold ice caves and more!

notes.title: Hot fix update, Huge Performance Boost. Bug's cleaned up.
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I noticed some bugs/performance issues. So I updated the game accordingly.

A couple of things that changed/reworked since the big update:

-Sneaking is changed and more clear, if you crouch a blue tint will appear and notify that you are currently in "Stealth Mode". When you are in stealth mode monsters can't hear you from the back and sides. This way you can sneak up on them and sneak attack with a melee weapon.

-Teleporting now always places you 100% accurate on the place you teleport, sometimes when you moved away from the middle of your play area your teleportation position would be wrong.

-bug removed in enemies that heavily dropped the overall frames per second. This caused the screen to flash in bigger area's 

-Rooms have been cleaned and optimized to improve overall performance

-Feature to disable High render effects to improve frame rate.

-Feature to disable real time shadows to improve frame rate.

-Feature to enable/disable Full body rendering (Default: off). Disabling improves frame rate.

-Feature to select teleportation only mode. Which replaces the touch pad with teleportation instead of walking.

-Adjusted teleportation to follow the height of stairs and objects.

-Fixed the issue spawning the player outside of the next room.

-Damage and weight are now shown correctly above all weapons.

-Changed online bug where enemies keep attacking a dead player.


And that's about it!

This patch should boost your overall performance, If you have trouble with that It could be completely gone together with the new rendering options.

So if you had trouble running the game, try again and do tell if it helped you out!

-Thomas Blackjard Softworks

notes.title: The New BIG Patch has Launched! READ ALL THE NEW ADDITIONS HERE!
notes.content:
VR Dungeon knight is becoming better("bugfree") and bigger each day!

Thanks to you guys, we have come so far already within the first month, great feedback has been given and a lot of things have been changed and added!
Lets get right into the changes!

NEW GAMEPLAY ADDITIONS:

-No longer press/release the trigger button to attack/defend! Swing your weapon against the enemy and block their attacks by moving your weapon against theirs before they hit you! Takes some practice, good luck!

-Full body rendering! For both single player and multiplayer. You have Arms, legs and feet! For the full immersion experience. (Enable this in the options chamber)

-Bows have stock and need reloading! Equip a Arrow quiver to your belt and pull arrows out by holding the trigger button!

-Two handed weapons can be swung with 1 hand, with 40% of its max damage.
This way you can equip a spear and a shield and other combinations.

-XP! You level up! Defeating monsters finding XP books around the dungeon and completing dungeon levels your character.

-New Chamber of Heroes! Spend your level up points for stats. Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence. These give negatives and buffs for you hero.

-Chamber of Heroes Side Quest, solve the riddle and explore a mysterious cave.

-New enemies to defeat in the dungeons! (Or kill you).

-New Dungeon system, *Normal Dungeons and **Nightmare Dungeons.
* Normal Dungeons act like the old dungeons and have a short length and are less spooky.
** Nightmare Dungeons get harder and larger each time you defeat one,

-New Music Tracks!

-New Weapons!

notes.title: New Patch Has released! Teleportation movement, New Weapons, Online Tavern.
notes.content:
Hi guys!

I hope you are all having a nice weekend. Let's get right into the additions/changes:

NEW ADDITIONS:

-*Online Tavern. Drink. Meet other players. Get free loot chest's.
-Teleport System. Against motion sickness. (Uses the application button).
-Touch pad movement without swinging arms. You can change this in the main chamber with the door next to the stairs.

-5 new Weapons. Good luck unlocking them! It's a surprise what they are.
-New Dungeon Structures.

*The online tavern is in early alpha. Send me your experience and feedback! The online tavern connects all players into the same room. The tavern does not have a name yet, send suggestions if you think of one!*

General bug fixes and Tweaks:

-You can't climb anymore with a weapon in your hand.
-Volume levels should be more subtle and balanced, making it easier to hear.
-Multiplayer is more stable.
-Dungeon traps now do damage in multiplayer.
-Bows can now be rotated to shoot more awesome.
-Bows make sound now
-Equipping items to your belt is easier. The range is bigger.
-The game now prioritizes items on the floor instead of your belt, making it easier to pick up items instead of unintentionally grabbing a belt item.

-Final Boss now moves again.
-Final Boss Projectiles attack duration reduced from 15 to 8 seconds.
-General bug fixes, balancing.
-Bows do less damage, making them less effective against bigger enemies.
-Damage and Weight are now shown above the weapons (The level of the weapon amplifies this. This is not yet shown).

What I am working on now:

-I was going to include larger area's in this patch. But they need a little more polishing first, removing some of the bugs and glitches. But they will arrive very soon, early next week.
-Movement based on controller direction instead of your head.
-Xp and skills system.

Bugs that I am aware of and try to fix:

-Vitality challenge bug.
-Enemies not responding to arrows from longer distances.
-Multiplayer bug where you can't move.
-Multiplayer Room not showing up, leaving you in darkness.

A lot of time went into all of this, I hope you guys like the progress!
I'm doing this all by myself and I really enjoy making more content.

Thanks for all of the feedback and suggestions, I can work really fast and create great additions thanks to you guys!

Have a very nice day,

-Thomas Blackjard Softworks.

notes.title: New patch! Dungeon traps! Final boss Updated!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I hope you are all doing great!

The new patch has launched with general bug fixes and new dungeon structures.

I did a lot of general bug fixes and some more specific ones mentioned here:

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

-Weapons don't stack anymore in your belt on the same spot, this was not intended and could lead to confusion.

-Dying works better. You now hear a death tune and return to the main chamber faster.

-Chest Payout changed, you no longer get chests from challenges, but you can still unlock the bonus room if you manage to get all 3.

-You have a chance that a dungeon is longer as normal, in that case your payout in chests goes from 1 to 3.

-The final boss now shoots an energy ball as a third attack.*

*This orb can be blocked with your weapon/shield to deflect and redirect it back to him, starting a back and forth sequence, if the ball manages to hit him, he will fall. After that you can do critical hits with your weapon.*

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

New Features:

-Traps! Dodge blades in hallways and climb over acid pits!.

-New Climbing Structure.

-Final Boss Reworked. You can win the fight without a ranged weapon.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Features I'm currently working on for the near future:

-New loco-motions.
-Mini bosses.
-Puzzle orientated rooms.
-Facing direction when you enter doors.
-New Weapons.
-Weapon Stats above the weapons. (Indicating strike speed, damage and weight).
-Bow Reload System, limited arrows supply per dungeon for the bow.
-XP and levels.
-Player Perks.
-Public Co-op. (Without using steam friends).

notes.title: VR Dungeon Knight, What's it going to be? Who Is making this game?
notes.content:
Hi, my name is Thomas, I'm 23 and I made this game all by myself,
I'm working on this game full time and I put a lot of time and love into it!

The last 2 weeks working to the release have been extremely busy but I can't wait to tell you what this game is and what will be added in the future!
The game also had a small delay because of some unexpected issues (sorry!)

Now to the exciting stuff:

The game Currently has:

GAME-PLAY:

-Free movement system (move around like in real life, walk, run crawl, climb)
-Loot system.
-Online Co-op play (No open matchmaking - Limited to your steam friends).
-Stealth element. (you can win dungeon's without being seen).
-Weapon Unlock systems.
-Weapon Level up system.
-Ranged Weapons, Melee Weapons. (swords, daggers, shields, bow).
-A lot of different dungeon's you can enter.
-Full Tutorial explaining all controls.
-Final Boss fight (still work in progress).

STORY:
The game has professional voice acting and will inform you what to do, and what your main goal is. The biggest goal is to defeat the Final Boss.

ALREADY CONFIRMED FEATURES IN THE FUTURE:

-Partial Teleport Movement system (coming very soon, against motion sickness).
-Skill/perk system.
-XP/level up system.
-Different Armor
-Secrets to be found and solved
-Puzzle elements
-Dungeon Traps (Spikes, obstacles etc).
-Mini bosses.
-Arena Survival game mode.
-Spell books and magic.
-Expanded and more refined Final boss fight.
-More Story elements.

You can leave questions and Suggestions in the discussion section, I will try and reply as fast as possible, I'm still learning everyday and I hope you can help me make this game bigger and better. 

I think there is a solid base to make a great game!
Will you help me get there? <3

-Thomas Blackjard Softworks
